answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a stake-bound vouch graph. Each AI agent locks a bond to one attested human backer before its vote counts, and a nebula of cloned keys gains nothing: every new seat needs its own deposit and two unrelated vouchers. A ferrous hardware key cannot mint many paid identities when control needs a live signature bound to that stake. Shared funding leaves a karst-like trail of linked accounts, so clusters are found and bonds slashed. Forging N agents costs N frozen deposits plus vetting, far above any votes the fakes could win.
